dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the central and posterior regions exhibit high-contrast, irregular white perimeters. The geometry transitions sharply from low-intensity dark pixels on the exterior to a thin, jagged, high-intensity white boundary, enclosing a slightly lighter dark-gray interior gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior region (left), with lower-density, isolated white-pixel clusters scattered along the dorsal ridge. Localized clusters of solid low-intensity pixels are nested within the interlocking ring structures of the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three large annuli in the mid-posterior region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of smaller annuli in the lower-central region forms a tight, irregular quadrilateral pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, linear, high-intensity white structures, likely environmental debris, are visible adhering to the fur on the posterior-lateral and mid-lateral surfaces. No clear permanent biological scars or tissue lesions are visible.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated lattice is formed where multiple annuli converge in the mid-section, creating a honeycomb-like topological structure that is distinct from the isolated rings found elsewhere on the body.
